Page code itself has zero useEffect fetches, matching the 'no on-mount fetch in the page code' claim. Consider deduplicating the double auth/me call at the AuthProvider level (looks like a React 18 StrictMode double-invoke or two mount points) for a minor perf/cleanliness win — non-blocking.

Consider a Jest test with a mocked checkerInitiate returning state='effective' to keep this path covered.
